$comment: Registry of repositories the jira-bug-analysis skill can analyze. 'group' controls the local directory (core -> <workspace>/core, apps -> <workspace>/apps). 'hints' power target-repo inference in step 4: match against Jira components, labels, and free text. Add more repos here to extend coverage; keep clone URLs as https://github.com/... so the session git proxy rewrite applies.
